title: Longest word in a sentence
description: Write a function `longest_word(sentence)` that splits a sentence on whitespace and returns the longest word. If several words tie for longest, return the first one encountered. This combines string splitting with a loop that tracks the best value seen so far.
hints: You'll first need to break the sentence up into individual words before comparing them.
`sentence.split()` splits on whitespace and gives you a list of words to loop over.

Split the sentence into a list of words. Keep a variable holding the longest word found so far, starting as the first word. Loop over the remaining words and, using `len`, replace it only when you find a STRICTLY longer word - this keeps the first longest one on ties.
expected_behavior: Returns the longest word (as a string) from the sentence, using whitespace splitting. On ties, the earliest-occurring longest word wins.
explanation: `sentence.split()` turns the sentence into a list of words. Starting `longest` at the first word and only replacing it when a later word is strictly longer (`>`, not `>=`) guarantees that on a tie the earliest longest word is kept.
